outcome: Percentage difference between hemoglobin levels before and after operation
Percentage of patients who lost more than 500ml blood
cohort: 130 females scheduled for elective cesarean surgery were randomized into a study group (TXA + routine care) or a control group (routine care).
finding: Tranexamic Acid administration during elective cesarean section significantly reduced blood loss and the incidence of a greater than 10% drop in hemoglobin, with no reported adverse effects.
